title: Liz Zips the Bag
lines: Liz has a red bag. It can zip up.
Liz gets a bun. Liz gets a fig.
It is in the bag. Zip!
Liz runs up a big log.
A bug zips at Liz. It is big!
The bug zigs. The bug zags.
Liz zips the bag up. The bug sits.
Liz sits on the log. Liz has the bun.
Liz gets a bit. The bug gets a bit.
The bug is not mad. Liz is not sad.

questions.ask: What did Liz put in the bag?
questions.listenFor: A bun and a fig. If your child only names one, that is fine - ask "what else?" and let them look back.

questions.ask: Why did Liz zip the bag up?
questions.listenFor: To keep the bug out of her food. The story does not say it in those words, so working it out together is the point.

questions.ask: Do you think Liz did the right thing at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason - she shared, or the bug stopped being mad. A reason from the story beats a yes or no.
